title: Woe to Jerusalem

questions.question: Ah, Ariel, Ariel, the city where who encamped!
I will distress Ariel, and there shall be moaning and what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 29:2 (ESV): "there shall be moaning and lamentation,"

questions.question: And the multitude of your foes shall be like small dust, and the multitude of the ruthless like passing what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 29:5 (ESV): "and the multitude of the ruthless like passing chaff."

questions.question: You will be visited by the LORD of hosts with thunder and with earthquake and great what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 29:6 (ESV): "with thunder and with earthquake and great noise,"

questions.question: The vision of all this has become to you like the words of a book that is what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 29:11 (ESV): "like the words of a book that is sealed."

questions.question: Because this people draw near with their mouth and honor me with their lips, while their hearts are far from whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 29:13 (ESV): "while their hearts are far from me,"

questions.question: And their fear of me is a commandment taught by whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 29:13 (ESV): "is a commandment taught by men."

questions.question: Therefore, behold, I will again do wonderful things with this people, with wonder upon wonder; and the wisdom of their wise men shall what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 29:14 (ESV): "and the wisdom of their wise men shall perish,"

questions.question: Ah, you who hide deep from the LORD your counsel, whose deeds are in the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 29:15 (ESV): "whose deeds are in the dark,"

questions.question: You turn things upside down! Shall the potter be regarded as the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 29:16 (ESV): "Shall the potter be regarded as the clay,"

questions.question: Is it not yet a very little while until Lebanon shall be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field shall be regarded as a what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 29:17 (ESV): "and the fruitful field shall be regarded as a forest?"

questions.question: In that day the deaf shall hear the words of a book, and out of their gloom and darkness the eyes of the blind shall what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 29:18 (ESV): "the eyes of the blind shall see."

questions.question: The meek shall obtain fresh joy in the LORD, and the poor among mankind shall exult in the Holy One of whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 29:19 (ESV): "exult in the Holy One of Israel."

questions.question: For the ruthless shall come to nothing and the scoffer cease, and all who watch to do evil shall be cut what?
Therefore thus says the LORD, who redeemed whom, concerning the house of Jacob: "Jacob shall no more be ashamed..."
questions.explanation: Isaiah 29:22 (ESV): "Therefore thus says the LORD, who redeemed Abraham,"

key_verse_text: And the Lord said: "Because this people draw near with their mouth and honor me with their lips, while their hearts are far from me, and their fear of me is a commandment taught by men..."
